videos.title: London Congestion Charge Shifted Jams to Boroughs
videos.hook: London's congestion charge cut traffic inside the zone by 15 percent — and shifted the jams and fumes to the boroughs just beyond its boundary.

videos.title: FHA VA Loans Built 10 Million Segregated Suburbs
videos.hook: Post-war mortgage subsidies made homeownership reachable for millions of families — and built the car-dependent, racially segregated suburbs that later proved nearly impossible to change.
